rationale: The frozen three-seed development comparison is complete. Augmented cross-entropy TCN B has mean 16-case macro-F1 0.82777 versus 0.71124 for unaugmented cross-entropy A and 0.68949 for the forest, which is outside the declared 0.01 simpler-model margin. SupCon plus the same augmentation D averages 0.82689; its paired D-B changes are +0.00239, -0.00401 and -0.00102, failing the declared all-seed and mean-gain rule. Use the predeclared deployment seed 17. These are development results; the held-out test has not influenced this decision.
